name: Account Modal
description: Opens account links (login/register/reset) in a modal window.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Description 
 Account Modal lets you:

 
 Open the following account pages in a modal
 
 Account page (/user/%uid) 
 Login page 
 Register page 
 Password reset page 
 Profile add/edit pages (if using Profile module) 
 
 
 Submit the opened forms via AJAX 
 Show errors in the dialog without reloading 
 Optionally reload after success instead of redirecting 
 If using Profile, you can pop up a profile create dialog after user registration.
